title: ArbiterEvidenceBundle
description: Schema for arbiter task evidence bundles stored in .evidence/task-NNN/. Every bundle must record the TDD red/green test paths, gate result, and optional artifact list. Enforced by INV-90 via scripts/check-evidence-bundle.mjs.

taskId.description: Task identifier in GitHub issue format, e.g. '#883'.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this bundle was recorded.

gateResult.description: Result of the quality gate at the time this bundle was recorded.

redTestPath.description: Relative path to the test file that was written in the red phase (failing tests).

greenTestPath.description: Relative path to the test file that passed after implementation (green phase). May be the same as redTestPath.

artifacts.description: Optional list of artifact files associated with this evidence bundle (e.g. test output, coverage reports).

provenance.description: Optional author provenance (#2164): what produced this bundle (model/harness/config/gate snapshot/session). Omitted when not derivable in the current environment; never invented.

provenance_note.description: Optional free-text note explaining why provenance is absent (#2164).

path.description: Relative path to the artifact file from the repository root.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type of the artifact (e.g. 'text/plain', 'application/json').

Provenance.description: Author provenance (#2164). Every field is an opaque id or a sha256 hex digest — never file content or transcript text.

model_id.description: Model identifier, when derivable from the harness environment. Omitted when not observable — never guessed.

harness_version.description: Harness version, structurally parsed from the harness executable path.

gate_manifest_hash.description: sha256 of the gate orchestrator script (scripts/check-all.mjs) — fingerprints which gates ran.

session_id.description: Opaque agent session id — not a transcript.

ConfigHashes.description: sha256 digests of governing config files, never their raw content.
